import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool
MLS_PHOTO_URL = 'https://mls-partner.example.com/api/v2/listings/{listing_id}/photos'

def _upload_photo(listing_id: str, path: Path) -> int:
    with path.open('rb') as fh:
        resp = requests.post(MLS_PHOTO_URL.format(listing_id=listing_id), files={'photo': (path.name, fh, 'image/jpeg')}, timeout=30)
    return resp.status_code

@tool
def archive_and_syndicate_listing_photos(listing_id: str, intake_dir: str, published_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(intake_dir) / listing_id
    dest = Path(published_dir) / listing_id
    if not src.is_dir():
        return f'No intake folder found for listing {listing_id}'
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Clean out leftover temp/partial files from the intake folder
    for leftover in list(src.glob('*.tmp')) + list(src.glob('*.part')):
        leftover.unlink()
    moved = 0
    failed = []
    for photo in sorted(src.glob('*.jpg')):
        target = Path(shutil.move(str(photo), str(dest / photo.name)))
        status = _upload_photo(listing_id, target)
        if status >= 400:
            failed.append(target.name)
        moved += 1
    return f"Moved {moved} photos for {listing_id}; upload failures: {failed or 'none'}"
